subject.title: feat: configure metadata (contextWindow, maxTokens, etc.) for custom provider setup

question: After the preservation bugs are fixed, should OpenClaw accept this configure-time custom-provider metadata editor as the interactive implementation path for #61716?
rationale: The patch adds a public setup surface for provider/model metadata, and repository policy treats setup/config/provider routing behavior as compatibility-sensitive product direction.

options.title: Accept After Preservation Fixes
options.body: Repair the modality, API override, and tiered-pricing preservation defects, keep scope custom-provider-only, and review the result as the candidate interactive metadata workflow.

options.title: Fold Into Unified Setup Design
options.body: Pause this PR and route the work through a broader design that covers configure, onboarding, and non-interactive custom-provider metadata consistently.

options.title: Defer To Narrower Context-Window Work
options.body: Keep this PR paused while the narrower non-interactive context-window flag and related validation issues carry the immediate custom-provider context-window work.

recommendation.title: Accept After Preservation Fixes
recommendation.body: Repair the modality, API override, and tiered-pricing preservation defects, keep scope custom-provider-only, and review the result as the candidate interactive metadata workflow.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is recent custom-provider context-window/configuration work and docs in the same setup boundary.
